Featuring premium ingredients, these dog flea and tick treatment chews are made under strict quality standards and are suitable for all breeds and ages. authors_reviews.title: Easy to Give and My Dog Loves Them!
authors_reviews.text: I can't personally speak to exactly how much these chews help prevent fleas and ticks on their own because we already use flea and tick collars as part of our dog's regular prevention routine. However, with how bad fleas can get here in Washington, I'm all for adding another layer of protection if it helps.The biggest win for us is that my dog absolutely loves these chews. He thinks they're treats and gets excited every time I pull out the container, which makes daily use effortless. No wrestling with sprays, topical treatments, or trying to hide medication in food.I also like that these chews contain ingredients that support skin, coat, and overall wellness in addition to flea and tick prevention. Whether they're helping keep pests away, supporting healthy skin, or both, I feel good about adding them to my dog's daily routine.The container lasts a long time, the chews are easy to serve, and my dog enjoys them. If you're looking for a convenient supplement to add to your flea and tick prevention plan, these are definitely worth trying. So far, they've been a great addition for us!

other_countries_reviews.title: Flea and Tick Prevention Chewables - far better results than expected
other_countries_reviews.text: With the extremely warmer weather than we are used to in this country, the dog was feeling the strain, even on walks during the cooler morning hours. Whilst waiting for this product to arrive for review, I was surprised to see a couple of fleas moving about in her short coat. It was easy enough to kill these and knew just where she had picked them up. Normally I would have immediately reached for the usual vet-prescribed drops but waited a day and began to offer these chews.Enriched with neem leaf extract, coconut oil, and apple cider vinegar. Together with Flaxseed, fish oil, and biotin designed to nourish from within and help reduce shedding and support a shinier coat. Along with Zinc and Vitamin E to support the skin barrier, with Beta-Carotene which contains natural antioxidants to help support hydration and comfort for your dog. These seems to be a wide array of ingredients but nothing there that I was worried about and I was pleased to see the usual chemicals found in flea prevention were not present. Natural, and that made my day when I read the pack.These look (and must taste) just like ordinary dog treats and the dog ate them without any problem and even looked up for more. A large pack of 200 chews but you do need to have an idea of your dog's weight so that you can give the required daily amount.Within a few days, not only was there no sign of any more fleas but I could see the dog's coat had improved, it had a healthy sheen to it, and she was no longer biting at a patch of skin that had seemed to be irritating her (probably where the fleas had landed during a walk with other dogs).I delayed writing this review to give a couple of weeks of dosing and am pleased to report that I have found no negatives at all. Far easier than trying to apply drops, probably safer with the lack of chemicals, and a very happy dog that thinks she is getting a reward with each chew. I will certainly buy these again in the future, they definitely work as described and are worth the money to have a happy (and clean) dog.
other_countries_reviews.author: Rain Bow

other_countries_reviews.title: Convenient daily flea treatment - doggo approved
other_countries_reviews.text: My dog hates getting her fur wet so applying any sort of spot on flea treatment directly onto the fur often results in her trying to roll around on the rug to get rid of it! These are a natural chicken flavoured chew that offer natural protection that she enjoys.The chews are formulated with natural ingredients like coconut oil, neem and brewer’s yeast. Each of these ingredients is supported by scientific research aimed at deterring pests.The dosage amount varies depending on the size of your pet and is listed on the tub. My dog requires 3 a day so I've been splitting the dosage and giving one or two to her as a post walk reward - morning and evening, which she looks forward too and is now a part of our daily routine.Based on 3 a day one tub should last for around 66 days. At the current price of £21 (even cheaper with the current discount) they are quite affordable for the protection, ease and convenience that these provide.Overall both myself and doggo are very happy with these.
